market.summary: Tanzania has separate mainland TLSB public/national services, a Zanzibar public library board, public/private university networks and specialized institutional libraries. Koha is the strongest evidenced adapter opportunity, but network reach is not the same as an open searchable catalog. Five independent institutions/networks returned specific books in this bounded test; four used Koha and one a custom ZLSB OPAC. This feasibility sample is not national LMS market share.
market.platform_strategy: Prioritize a policy-aware Koha adapter for SNAL, SUZA, MUST and DarTU; preserve direct detail redirects and reference-only locations. ZLSB needs a custom result/modal parser with catalog-listed status only. Keep TLSB iNDLS as the largest public-network opportunity pending a documented anonymous interface. COTUL is a coordination and resource-licensing route, not a verified national physical-book union endpoint.

adoption_evidence.claim: 2019 dissertation purposively studied Koha-implementing OUT, IFM and CBE libraries in Dar es Salaam; supports local adoption, not prevalence.
Current official Ardhi library page explicitly identifies Koha.
Four successful current catalog endpoints identify Koha; ZLSB is custom. Historical ABCD reports for Sokoine/Mzumbe should not override observed current Koha branding.
Makumira official page identifies Mandarin Oasis and 150,000 entered records; live endpoint identifies Mandarin 5.7.11 but startup fails.

limitations: Five selected successful institutions/networks; explicit five-target shortfall after investigating major libraries and meaningful alternatives.
No national largest-ten ranking established. Differing dates, book/copy/title/material units and institutional proxies are not comparable rankings.
Koha has strong scoped evidence; no national LMS shares estimated.
TLSB iNDLS currently 11 libraries in dated official evidence, not full43; no open physical query verified.
ZLSB 50,000+ title marketing claim conflicts with OPAC2,002+; In Collection is not item-level availability.
MUST selection uses a university-wide institutional proxy with no numeric size. DarTU size is indexed official evidence, not a directly fetched PDF.
Only small public GET searches and detail reads were performed; no app adapter, live circulation, membership, holds, credentials or authenticated flows tested.
Failed requests or robots exclusions do not mean an institution lacks a book.
Tuma catalog session URLs and ephemeral form tokens are redacted from stored bodies/metadata; retain fresh public-form recipe rather than token reuse.
